lagged_diagnostics.interpretation: No past-only diagnostic had a stable direction across all schedules, directions and both targets; no live adaptive gate is supported.

formal_conclusion: Hard rolling windows materially reduce training sample size.
Rolling and expanding rankings already disagree on the previous complete month before validation outcomes are known.
Validation-month rank overlap deteriorates further, especially for shorter windows.
SHORT rolling-exclusive selections have materially lower realized label rates than EXPANDING-exclusive selections for all rolling windows.
Sample loss alone is insufficient because its relation to AUC delta is weak and sign-inconsistent.
PSI, class-rate change, sample ratio and past-only model disagreement do not consistently predict next-month AUC or P90-lift delta.
Stage32 cannot authorize a live adaptive gate, signal, schedule or PnL opening.
